original_test_intent: Exercise and verify each defined OOB IPMI Chassis Control behavior for the intended host chassis, with option-specific power, reset, interrupt or ACPI observations.
original_method: Send raw Chassis NetFn 0x00 command 0x02 with a selected control byte and judge the corresponding physical/OS/SEL behavior.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE selects one control option, maintenance window, workload state, observers, timing and recovery; operator remains available for physical or console recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not put password in argv/evidence
agent_execution_scope: Execute the allowlisted 0x00/0x02 request once only when separately authorized
Correlate command completion with physical/OS/SEL behavior
engineer_actions: Judge workload/data integrity and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The power-on wrapper covers only control 0x01 and cannot represent power-down, cycle, reset, NMI or ACPI-shutdown coverage; argv credentials are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected, one-shot raw 0x00/0x02 runner with an exact approved control-byte allowlist and independent observers; never iterate the matrix automatically.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All six source options, criteria, Script path and 10/5 timing remain preserved, with timing adequacy subject to Project plan.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute each required option as a separately approved disruptive trial on a recovery-capable SUT, verify its distinct effect and restore baseline before another trial.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-option authorization, workload protection, objective observers and recovery without reducing the source option matrix.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Power-on alone proves only option 0x01; command completion does not prove power sequencing, OS shutdown, NMI logging or reset recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Options can interrupt workloads, corrupt data, fail to boot, generate NMI/SEL side effects or strand the host offline.

project_override_considerations: A high-level tool may replace the raw transport only for the same approved option with equivalent target, semantics and evidence; it cannot collapse or claim unexecuted options, and the BMC-cold-reset Script name is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Pre/post chassis, host, console, power/LED and SEL state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, raw 0x00/0x02 command and six option definitions align. The mismatched Script name and weak Criteria are review-layer limitations, but the primary operation remains unambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Chassis Control semantics are defined. Target, option, window, observers and recovery are Project execution-readiness inputs requiring approval.

review_improvement: Restores the six-option source coverage, rejects power-on as a representative shortcut, separates command completion from behavior and gates every disruptive action behind explicit approval and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The six control bytes are not interchangeable: power-down/on/cycle/reset affect power and boot sequencing, diagnostic interrupt requires host/SEL correlation, and ACPI shutdown depends on OS/platform handling. Each therefore needs its own oracle and recovery boundary; success of one option cannot establish another and no sequence may be automatically repeated.
